The fingers are elongated and adorned with rings and bracelets, and the skin is a flat, desaturated gray. The head is tilted far back, exposing the neck, which is covered in intricate occult symbols that disappear beneath the flowing folds of the garment. A single light source - a pulsing red field above - casts hard, directional highlights along the folds of the fabric, the rings, and the limbs, while the recesses of every fold fall into absolute black.
